# QA only — reviewer edits for product-generated P3 v1

Do not upload as source evidence. Use after Nexus generates P3 v1. Apply edits in the product human-edit/revision flow. Pass requires a new version, preserved v1, reviewer/rationale, and downstream generation consuming the exact approved v2.

1. Remove any unqualified claim that average handle time will fall by 20%. SYN-CONFLICT-01 leaves the baseline unresolved. Replace with a measurement hypothesis and require Finance validation.
2. Replace any statement that the assistant will approve/deny eligibility, claims, coverage, clinical, or authorization outcomes. It may retrieve source status only; the agent stays accountable. Cite RL-02.
3. Remove automatic CRM/claims writeback from initial scope. Keep the read-only panel and human confirmation boundary. Cite RL-03.
4. Mark proposed interfaces as unverified assumptions, not production-ready APIs. Cite SYN-SYS-01 and SYN-DATA-01.
5. Add stale/conflicting knowledge abstention for K-014. Cite SYN-CONFLICT-02 and RL-06.
6. Keep P3 estimate-ready. Do not produce detailed future queue procedures, full operational RACI, or a complete organization redesign.
7. Add version note: Human revision v2 supersedes draft v1 for review; no phase gate is approved until an accountable reviewer approves this exact version.

Record each applied edit with source/evidence reference. If a reviewer rejects a proposed change, record why.
